name: rdap.org RDAP redirector
tier_rationale: Volunteer-run RDAP redirector with public documentation (A8 community); P003 'rdap.org (community tier, volunteer-run) is only a fallback, following its 302'.

reliability.justification: A redirector, not a data source: answers come from the registry it redirects to, and its own 404 never means 'not registered' (P003).

redirector.title: rdap.org redirector /domain, /ip, /autnum, /entity (302 to the authoritative RDAP server)

terms.quote: registro.br RDAP is default-on by decision (A3 BR9). Tier community because rdap.org, a volunteer redirector, receives values on fallback; registries are trusted. Terms open (public registry data).

redirector.notes: Quote: council chair rationale (P003). rdap.org/domain|ip|autnum|entity answer 302 to the authoritative RDAP server, whose provider the module also declares (rdap.registro.br is in registrobr) (research C0006). Fallback only: the authoritative server is queried first through the IANA bootstrap (P003). Per-query lookups only, no bulk harvesting; registry terms apply.

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G01-1, p9-G01-1: batches only extend it (rdap_org__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). rdap.org/ itself redirects to about.rdap.org (documentation), which no module contacts. RDAP ttl 24 h (TTL_CLASSES).
